DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 棚板を探していますが、自分の寸法メモで幅と厚さが分からなくなりました。このまま切ってもらわず、メモを整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚板寸法メモの幅厚さが不明で加工前に整理したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking for a shelf board, but I can no longer tell which measurements in my notes are the width and thickness. Rather than have it cut as they stand, I'd like to sort out my notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about clarifying your shelf measurements before cutting because you are unsure which notes refer to width and thickness. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの寸法が分からなくなりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which measurements are you unsure about?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 八十と三十と二があります。単位はセンチですが、どれが奥行きだったか書き忘れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 八十・三十・二センチの数値があり奥行きの記載を忘れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have eighty, thirty, and two. The units are centimeters, but I forgot to write which was the depth.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have measurements of eighty, thirty, and two centimeters but forgot to identify the depth. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の棚を確認する必要がありますね。今の数字だけでは加工寸法を確定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You'll need to check the original shelf. We can't finalize the cutting dimensions from these numbers alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は切断を頼みません。家で幅と奥行き、板の厚さを別々に測り、簡単な図に矢印で書いて来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日は切断せず幅奥行き厚さを再測定し矢印図を作ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't request any cutting today. At home, I'll measure the width, depth, and board thickness separately and bring a simple diagram with arrows marking them.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not have it cut today, but will remeasure the width, depth, and thickness and draw a diagram with arrows. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 板が載る受け具の間隔も、選ぶ時に確認するとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's also worth checking the spacing between the supports the board rests on when choosing one.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受け具の位置も図に入れます。ただ、何を載せるかで必要な板が変わると思うので、置く物も説明できるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受け具位置と置く物も説明できるよう準備すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll add the support positions to the diagram. I think the board I need will also depend on what I put on it, so I'll be ready to explain that, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will prepare to explain both the support positions and the items you will put on the shelf. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 再度ご相談の際は、寸法と用途をお持ちください。材料の候補を一緒に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you consult us again, please bring the measurements and intended use. We can look at possible materials together.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は材料の売場だけ見ます。採寸図と置く物のメモを用意して、加工を頼む前にもう一度相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 材料売場だけ見て採寸と用途のメモを持ち加工前に再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll just look around the materials section. I'll prepare a measured diagram and notes on what I'll put on it, and consult you again before requesting cutting.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will only look around the materials section today, then return with measurement and usage notes before requesting any work. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日は加工せず、採寸後のご相談ですね。売場をご案内します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: So no cutting today; you'll consult us again after measuring. I'll show you the section. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。撮影の準備でお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you prepare for your photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 外が寒くて厚い上着で来ました。写真を撮る前に脱ぎたいのですが、呼ばれてから慌てず準備できる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 厚い上着を撮影前に脱ぐ準備場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It was cold outside, so I came in a thick coat. I'd like to take it off before the photo. Is there somewhere I can get ready without rushing after my name is called?
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for somewhere to prepare by taking off your thick coat before the photo. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 撮影案内はもうお受けになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you already received the photo instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これからです。上着のポケットに受付票を入れたので、脱いだ後も必要な物をすぐ出せるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撮影案内前で受付票が上着ポケットにあり取り出しやすくしたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. My reception slip is in my coat pocket, so I'd like to keep the things I need easy to reach after taking it off.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not yet received the photo instructions and want easy access to the reception slip in your coat pocket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 待合で整理できます。上着やかばんはご自身で管理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can organize your things in the waiting area. Please look after your coat and bag yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受付票を小さいかばんへ移します。上着を椅子に残して撮影へ行くのでなく、一緒に持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 票を小かばんへ移し上着も置き去りにせず持つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll move the reception slip to my small bag. I won't leave my coat on a chair when going for the photo; I'll take it with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will move the slip to a small bag and take your coat rather than leave it behind. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮影場所で荷物を置く位置は担当が案内します。お名前が呼ばれるのをお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will show you where to put your belongings at the photo area. Please wait for your name to be called.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、先に列へ入って呼出しを逃さないようにするのでなく、案内された待合で聞いて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勝手に撮影列へ入らず指定待合で呼出しを聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Rather than join the photo queue on my own to avoid missing the call, I'll listen and wait in the waiting area I've been directed to.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not join the photo queue without instructions but will listen for your name in the designated waiting area. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 撮影に関する条件で不明な点は、その場で担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you're unsure about any photo requirements, you can ask the staff there.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待合で上着と票を整理して待ちます。呼ばれたら荷物を持って行き、置場を聞いてから撮影に進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 上着票整理後名前を待ち荷物持参で置場確認後撮影すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll organize my coat and slip in the waiting area and wait. When called, I'll bring my belongings, ask where to put them, and then proceed with the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will organize your coat and slip, wait for your name, bring your belongings, and check where to put them before the photo. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備後もお名前の案内をお聞きください。撮影担当へお声がけいただけます。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep listening for your name after getting ready. You can speak to the photo staff. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like advice about mailing something?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と友人の書類を同じ宛先へ送ります。一つの封筒にまとめるつもりでしたが、別々に出すよう指定があるか確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ宛先の二人の書類を一封にしてよいか未確認と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sending my documents and my friend's to the same address. I planned to put them in one envelope, but haven't checked whether they must be sent separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you haven't confirmed whether two people's documents going to the same address may share one envelope. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取先からの案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the instructions from the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙です。宛先は同じですが、一人分ずつ受付番号を書く欄があります。まとめてよいとは書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内に一人分受付番号欄があり一封可の記載はないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. The destination is the same, but there's a field for each person's application number. It doesn't say that we may combine them.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the instructions have an application-number field for each person but do not say that one envelope is allowed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 応募条件の判断は受取先へ確認してください。こちらでは発送方法をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check with the recipient about the application requirements. We can advise you on shipping methods here.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に受取先へ問い合わせます。確認するまで二人の書類を混ぜず、それぞれの受付番号の紙と一緒に分けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取先へ問い合わせるまで各書類と番号を分けると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll contact the recipient first. Until it's confirmed, I won't mix our documents; I'll keep each person's documents with their application-number sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep each person's documents and number separate until you contact the recipient. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認後に封筒を決めていただけます。発送日は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can decide on the envelopes after checking. Have you decided when to mail them?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日までに差し出したいです。受取先にはまとめてよいかと、別封の場合の宛名の書き方を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 明日発送希望で一封可否と別封宛名を受取先へ聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to send them by tomorrow. I'll ask the recipient whether they can go together and how to address them if separate envelopes are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to mail them by tomorrow and will ask the recipient about one envelope or the addressing for separate envelopes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発送方法は、その確認後に重量とご希望に合わせてご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've checked, we can discuss a mailing method based on the weight and your preferences.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は封をせず持ち帰ります。受取先の回答に従って封筒を用意し、二人分の書類と番号を照合してから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は未封で持ち帰り回答通り準備し書類番号照合後発送すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take them home unsealed today. I'll prepare the envelopes according to the recipient's answer, match both people's documents to their numbers, and then send them.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will take them home unsealed, prepare as instructed, and mail them after matching the documents and numbers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 封筒を決める前のご相談ですね。受取先への確認後に発送をご案内します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-BANDO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You're asking before choosing the envelopes, then. We'll explain shipping after you've checked with the recipient. Thank you.

DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。検査のことで何か手伝いましょうか。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with the inspection?

DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 測定中に画面が消えました。数字を読み終えていない部品があるので、そのまま合格にせず止めています。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 測定表示が消え未確認品を合格にせず停止したと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-02.translation: The display went blank during measurement. There is a part whose reading I hadn't finished checking, so I've stopped rather than pass it as it is.
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the measurement display went blank and that you stopped without passing the unchecked item. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 止まる前の記録は残っていますか。どこまで確認したか教えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have records from before it stopped? Please tell me how far you checked.

DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 七個目までは記録しました。八個目を測っていた時に消えたので、八個目の値は記入していません。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 七個目まで記録済みで八個目の値は未記入と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've recorded up to the seventh part. It went blank while I was measuring the eighth, so I haven't entered the eighth reading.
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you recorded through the seventh part but did not enter the eighth reading. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 八個目は未確認として分けましょう。機器を勝手に再起動しましたか。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's separate the eighth as unchecked. Have you restarted the equipment on your own?

DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ触っていません。八個目に未確認の札を付け、七個目までと別の箱に置きます。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再起動せず八個目へ未確認札を付け別箱に置くと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't touched it yet. I'll tag the eighth part as unchecked and put it in a separate box from the first seven.
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not restarted it and will tag the eighth part as unchecked and put it in a separate box. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。担当が機器を確認します。作業記録には何を残せますか。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. The responsible staff will check the equipment. What can you record in the work log?

DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 停止した時刻と機器番号を書けます。原因は分からないので、電池切れと決めて書くのは避けます。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 停止時刻と機器番号を記録し原因は推測しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can write the time it stopped and the equipment number. I don't know the cause, so I won't assume it was a dead battery and record that.
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the stopping time and equipment number without guessing the cause. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その記録でお願いします。再開してよいかは担当が判断します。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please record that. The responsible staff will decide whether work can resume.

DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 停止時刻と機器番号、八個目の測定値が未確認であることを報告します。再開の指示が出るまで、この機器での検査を止めます。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 八個目の測定値が未確認であることと停止情報を報告し再開指示を待つと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll report the stopping time, equipment number, and that the eighth reading is unverified. I'll stop inspections with this equipment until I'm told to resume.
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will report the unverified eighth reading and stoppage details and wait for instructions to resume. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認済みと未確認を分けた報告を受け取りました。担当へ引き継ぎます。お知らせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-IBR-HITACHI-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've received your report separating checked and unchecked items. I'll pass it to the responsible staff. Thank you for reporting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どちらの列車についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Which train are you asking about?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 向こうの列車に「回送」と出ています。席が空いているので乗れると思いましたが、乗る前に表示の意味を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空席のある回送列車へ乗る前に表示の意味を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The train over there displays 'out of service.' I thought I could board because there are empty seats, but I'd like to check what the sign means before getting on.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check what the out-of-service display means before boarding a train with empty seats. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 回送は、お客様を乗せる運行ではありません。空席が見えても、この列車には乗れません。どちらへ行く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: An out-of-service train isn't carrying passengers. Even if you see empty seats, you cannot board this train. Where are you planning to go?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 水戸方面へ行きたいです。線路がその方向へ続いていても、乗客用の列車だとは判断できないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的地を水戸方面と伝え移動方向だけでは乗車可否を判断できないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Toward Mito. Even if the tracks continue in that direction, I can't assume it's a passenger train, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that you are heading toward Mito and confirm that direction alone does not determine whether you can board. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。列車の移動方向だけで、乗車できるかは決まりません。乗車券をお持ちでも、回送列車の利用はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. Whether you can board isn't determined only by the train's direction of travel. You can't use an out-of-service train even if you have a ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗車券があるので特別に乗れるか聞こうと思いましたが、そのお願いは取り下げます。乗客用の列車を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗車券による特別乗車の依頼を取り下げ乗客用列車を待つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was going to ask whether I could board as a special case because I have a ticket, but I'll withdraw that request. I'll wait for a passenger train.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Withdraw your request to board as a special case on the basis of having a ticket and say that you will wait for a passenger train. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 水戸方面の乗客用列車について、案内表示を確認しましょう。どの時刻を見ていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the information display for a passenger train toward Mito. Which time were you looking at?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 回送列車が動き始める時刻を、自分が乗る列車の発車時刻だと思っていました。水戸方面の列車の発車時刻と乗り場を、別に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 回送列車の移動時刻と乗客用列車の発車時刻を区別して時刻と乗り場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I thought the time when the out-of-service train starts moving was my train's departure time. Please tell me the departure time and platform for a train toward Mito separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the movement time of the out-of-service train from a passenger train's departure time and ask for the time and platform. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お客様が利用する列車の時刻と乗り場をご案内します。実際に乗る時も、その列車の行き先表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll give you the time and platform for the train you can use. When you actually board, please also check that train's destination display.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内された乗り場で待ちます。列車が来たら水戸方面の行き先表示を確かめ、分からなければ乗る前に聞きます。先ほどの回送列車には乗りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内された乗り場で待ち実際の行き先表示を乗車前に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait at the platform you indicate. When the train arrives, I'll check that it's going toward Mito and ask before boarding if I'm unsure. I won't board that out-of-service train.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait at the indicated platform and check the actual destination display before boarding. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。乗車する列車の案内をご確認ください。お問い合わせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the information for the train you will board. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 出口へ向かう途中で買物袋の底が破れました。商品を詰め直したいので、置ける場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計後に袋底が破れ商品を置き詰め直す場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bottom of my shopping bag tore on the way to the exit. I'd like to repack my purchases. Please tell me somewhere I can put them down.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the bag bottom tore after checkout and ask for somewhere to put down and repack your purchases. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの台を使えます。床へ落ちた商品はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use this counter. Did anything fall onto the floor?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 缶が一つ落ちました。ほかは腕で支えています。落ちた缶は自分の物として分け、まず残りを台へ置きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 落ちた缶一つを分け腕で支えた残りを台へ置きたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: One can fell. I'm supporting the rest with my arms. I'll keep the fallen can separate as my own item and would first like to put the rest on the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will separate the one fallen can and put the remaining items you are holding on the counter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ置いてください。新しい袋が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please put them down. Do you need new bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、大きな袋一枚より、小さい袋二枚に分けたいです。缶を一方にまとめず重さを分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小さい袋二枚へ重さを分散したいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than one large bag, I'd like to divide them between two small ones. I'll spread the weight instead of putting all the cans in one.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to distribute the weight between two small bags. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋はレジで購入できます。商品を置いたまま、袋の会計だけして戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can buy bags at the checkout. You can leave your purchases here, pay just for the bags, and come back.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 商品とレシートはこの台にまとめます。袋を買う時、ここにある食品まで再度会計する必要がないと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入済み食品と袋だけの会計を区別したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll keep the purchases and receipt together on this counter. When buying bags, I'd like to explain that I don't need to pay again for the food here.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to distinguish the already purchased food from paying for bags only. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入済みの商品ですね。レシートをお持ちになり、袋だけ必要とレジでお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The items are already paid for, then. Take your receipt and tell the checkout staff that you only need bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: レシートを持って袋二枚だけ買います。戻って詰め直し、破れた袋の処分場所も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: レシートで袋二枚を買い詰め直して破れた袋の処分を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the receipt and buy just two bags. I'll come back to repack and also ask where to dispose of the torn bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the receipt to buy two bags, repack, and check how to dispose of the torn bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 袋を分けて詰め直すご相談ですね。レジをご案内します。お声がけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: You'd like to repack into separate bags, then. I'll show you the checkout. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 連れが別の入口で待っているようです。呼びに行きたいのですが、まだ注文していないことをお伝えしておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 連れを入口へ呼びに行くため未注文であると知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My companion seems to be waiting at another entrance. I'd like to go and get them, but I want to let you know we haven't ordered yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you haven't ordered yet and will go to the entrance to call your companion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人でお食事ですね。席には荷物を置かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You'll be dining as a party of two, then. Will you leave your belongings at the table?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: かばんは持って出ます。席が空いたように見えるので、戻る予定だと分かるようにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: かばんを持ち席を空けても戻る予定と分かる方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll take my bag with me. The table will look empty; is there a way to show that I plan to return?
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how to show that you plan to return even though you will leave the table with your bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 短い間でしたらこちらで把握します。お連れ様も同じ席へご案内してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: If it's only a short time, we'll keep track of it. May we show your companion to the same table, too?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、二人で戻ります。注文は連れがメニューを見てからにするので、今は何も調理しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人で戻りメニューを見てから注文するので調理を待ってほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, we'll come back together. We'll order after my companion looks at the menu, so please don't start preparing anything yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will return as a pair and order after looking at the menu, so you would like preparation to wait. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。お戻りまでご注文はお待ちします。お時間がかかりそうな場合はお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We'll wait for your order until you return. Please let us know if it looks as though you'll be away longer.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もし会えなければ先に私だけ戻ります。長く席を空けたまま探し続けることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会えなければ一人で先に戻り長時間探し続けないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I can't find them, I'll come back on my own first. I won't leave the table empty while continuing to search for a long time.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that if you cannot find your companion, you will return alone rather than keep searching for a long time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。戻られたら係にお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Please speak to a staff member when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: かばんを持って入口へ行き、連れを呼びます。戻ってから二人分を選び、係の方へ注文します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口へ連れを呼び戻って二人分を選び注文すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take my bag to the entrance and call my companion. When we return, we'll choose food for both of us and order from the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will call your companion at the entrance, return, choose for two, and order. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご注文前の一時的な離席として承りました。お戻りの際にお声がけください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted that you're briefly leaving before ordering. Please let us know when you return. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付でお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything I can help you with at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約して来ましたが、持ってくる検体を家に忘れました。空の容器を出すのでなく、忘れたことを先に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検体を忘れ空容器で提出済みにせず申告したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an appointment, but I forgot the sample I was supposed to bring at home. Rather than hand in an empty container, I'd like to tell you first that I forgot it.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you forgot the sample and want to report it rather than submit an empty container as though it had been handed in. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約票を確認します。ほかの持ち物はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check your appointment slip. Do you have the other required items?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約票と本人確認の書類はあります。検体だけ家にあるので、今日できる項目を担当に確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約票と確認書類はあり当日できる項目を確認してほしいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the appointment slip and identification. Only the sample is at home. Could you check with the responsible staff which tests can be done today?
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the appointment slip and identification and ask to check which items can be done today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。忘れた検体を後から提出する希望もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the staff. Would you also like to submit the forgotten sample later?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 可能なら希望します。ただ、いつでも持って来てよいと考えず、期限と受付場所を聞いてから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 後日提出を希望するが期限と場所を聞いてから決めると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: If possible, yes. But rather than assume I can bring it at any time, I'd like to decide after hearing the deadline and where to submit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to submit it later but will decide after checking the deadline and location. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 提出条件は担当が説明します。今日の検査についても変更の有無を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will explain the submission conditions. We'll also check whether today's tests need to change.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家へ取りに戻るよう案内された場合は、戻る時間に間に合うか考えます。今ここで提出済みとして記録しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 取りに戻る時間は案内後に判断し未提出のまま記録してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I'm told to go home to collect it, I'll consider whether I can return in time. Please don't record it as submitted here now.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will judge the time needed to collect it after receiving guidance and ask for it to remain recorded as not submitted. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 未提出としてお伝えします。担当が来るまで、予約票をお持ちになってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll report that it hasn't been submitted. Please wait with your appointment slip until the staff member comes.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約票を持って待ちます。当日できる項目と検体の提出条件を別々に聞き、案内を確認してから動きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日項目と検体提出条件を分けて聞き担当を待つと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait with my appointment slip. I'll ask separately about today's possible tests and the sample submission conditions, and follow the guidance after confirming it.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will wait for the staff and ask separately about today's tests and the sample submission conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 検体未提出のご申告を受けました。担当へ引き継ぎます。お知らせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've received your report that the sample hasn't been submitted. I'll pass it to the responsible staff. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 脱衣所で自分の袋だと思って持ち上げたら、違う名前が見えました。中は開けていません。係の方へ知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別名の袋を持ち上げたが開けていないと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: In the changing room, I picked up a bag thinking it was mine, then saw a different name. I haven't opened it. I'd like to let a staff member know.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you picked up a bag with someone else's name but have not opened it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらに置かれていた袋ですか。今はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where was the bag? Are you holding it now?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 棚の下段です。まだ手に持っています。勝手に別の棚へ移すより、元の位置をお伝えしてお渡ししたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 下段の元位置を伝え持っている袋を係へ渡したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the bottom shelf. I'm still holding it. Rather than move it to another shelf on my own, I'd like to tell you where it was and hand it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the original bottom-shelf location and say that you would like to hand the bag you are holding to the staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで確認します。ご自身の袋の特徴は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check it. Can you describe your own bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ紺色ですが、私の袋は持ち手に白いリボンがあります。この袋には付いていないので、自分の物ではないと気付きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の紺色袋には白リボンがあり取り違いに気付いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's the same navy color, but mine has a white ribbon on the handle. This one doesn't, so I realized it wasn't mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your navy bag has a white ribbon, which made you realize the mix-up. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取り違えた袋は係がお預かりします。ご自身の物は元の棚付近を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will hold the bag you picked up by mistake. Let's look together near the original shelf for yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、ほかの袋を順番に開けて探すことはしません。白いリボンを外側から確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他人の袋を開けず外側のリボンで探したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't open other bags one by one to search. I'd like to look for the white ribbon from the outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you won't open other people's bags but would like to identify yours by the ribbon outside. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの袋にリボンがあります。ご本人の物か、さらに確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: This bag has a ribbon. Can you make another check to confirm it's yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の名前札もあります。こちらが私の袋です。取り違えた方は係へお任せし、持ち帰りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名前札でも自分の袋を確認し別の袋は係へ任せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: It also has my name tag. This is my bag. I'll leave the mistaken one with the staff and won't take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your bag by the name tag as well and say that you will leave the other bag with the staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご自身の袋が確認できました。取り違えのご申告も受けました。お知らせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've identified your bag and received your report of the mix-up. Thank you for telling us.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便について何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with anything postal?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海外にいる娘へ手紙を送ります。娘が返事を書く時に私の住所を読めるよう、返信用の宛先を別の紙に書いて入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海外留学の娘が返信住所を読めるよう自分宛の見本紙を同封したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sending a letter to my daughter overseas. I'd like to enclose a separate sheet with the reply address so she can read my address when writing back.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about enclosing a sample addressed to yourself so your daughter studying overseas can read the reply address. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 娘さんは、日本語の住所を読みながら書けますか。別の表記も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can your daughter read and copy a Japanese address? Does she need another form of writing, too?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日本語は読めますが、海外から出す書き方には慣れていません。私の住所は変わっていないので、そのまま使える見本を用意したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 娘は日本語読めるが海外発送の記載に不慣れで変更なしの自住所見本を用意したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: She can read Japanese but isn't used to addressing mail from overseas. My address hasn't changed, so I'd like to prepare a sample she can use as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your daughter reads Japanese but is unfamiliar with addressing overseas mail, and you want a sample of your unchanged address. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛先の見本と、実際の返信用封筒を区別しましょう。娘さんが使う封筒や切手まで、こちらで用意するご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's distinguish an address sample from an actual reply envelope. Do you also want us to prepare the envelope and stamps your daughter will use?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ、封筒と料金は向こうで確認してもらいます。私の住所と名前を書いた見本だけを入れ、切手を貼れば済むと決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返信封筒切手は娘が現地確認し自住所氏名見本だけを同封すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I'll have her check the envelope and postage there. I'll only include a sample with my address and name, and won't assume all she needs to do is attach a stamp.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your daughter will check reply envelopes and stamps locally and that you will enclose only your address and name as a sample. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その形なら、見本に「返事を送る宛先」と書いて、手紙の送付先と混ざらないようにできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: In that case, you can label the sample 'address for sending a reply' so it won't be confused with the destination of this letter.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見本には私の名前と住所を書き、娘への宛先は外の封筒に書きます。娘の住所を返信先の見本へ写さないよう、二枚を離して確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見本は自分宛外封筒は娘宛を二枚離して照合し娘住所を返信先へ写さないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write my name and address on the sample and my daughter's address on the outer envelope. I'll keep the two sheets apart while checking so I don't copy her address onto the reply-address sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the sample is addressed to you and the outer envelope to your daughter, and that you will compare them separately to avoid copying her address as the reply address. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 娘さんへは、返信の出し方を現地の郵便窓口で確かめるよう、手紙の中でも伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also tell your daughter in the letter to check how to send her reply at a local post office.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そう書き添えます。私宛の見本を入れて、外の封筒が娘宛であることを確認してから、今日の発送の料金を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現地郵便で返信方法確認を手紙へ加え自宛見本と娘宛外封筒を確かめ今日発送料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll add that. I'll enclose the sample addressed to me, check that the outer envelope is addressed to my daughter, and then ask about the postage for sending it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will add advice to check reply mailing locally, verify your sample and your daughter's outer envelope, and ask today's postage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 送り先と返信先を分けた準備ですね。今日お出しになる封筒の料金を確認します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-HITACHI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You're preparing the destination and reply address separately, then. I'll check the postage for the envelope you're sending today. Thank you for consulting us.
